title: Widget management drawer
description: Board and ordering controls for widgets.

ui.overview: The Widget management drawer organizes widgets at the board level. Use it to reorder visible overlays and move them between scene and export boards.

controls.label: Board selector
controls.description: Switches between the scene board and the video board when both exist.

controls.label: Widget list
controls.description: Shows the widgets that belong to the current board and lets you change their order.

controls.label: Move widget
controls.description: Moves the selected widget to another board when the widget supports relocation.

controls.label: Remove widget
controls.description: Deletes the selected widget from the current composition.

controls.label: Reorder handle
controls.description: Drags a widget to change its order on the current board.

controls.label: Recenter
controls.description: Recenters the view on the chosen widget so you can find it in the composition.

controls.label: Edit
controls.description: Opens the Widgets editor drawer for the widget's properties.

steps.title: Choose the board
steps.description: Select Scene widgets or Video widgets according to the composition you want to organize.

steps.title: Reorder widgets
steps.description: Drag a widget handle to change its stacking or presentation order.

steps.title: Edit or remove
steps.description: Use Edit to open the editor, Recenter to find the widget, and Remove to take it out of the composition.

notes: This drawer is available from the widget management action, including the `Alt+W` shortcut when supported.
Use it when you need to rearrange overlays quickly without opening each widget editor.
